name: Kanzaki Kojirou
source:
Favorite Color: Black
Special Skills: Pretending to Listen
Hobby: Sweating at the Gym
Feelings Toward the Protagonist: Useless Newbie/It would be good if she listened to what I say

An editor at the publishing company Keigo is employed by.
A cool and composed guy who reads trends and makes important decisions about what to publish.
